'''Julie Gould''' (born 15 February 1989)<ref name=Gould>{{cite web |title=Julie Gould |url=http://www.britishswimming.org/vsite/vcontent/page/custom/0,8510,5026-166115-183333-35351-168065-custom-item |website=britishswimming.org |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060521191048/http://www.britishswimming.org/vsite/vcontent/page/custom/0,8510,5026-166115-183333-35351-168065-custom-item |access-date=2 August 2021 |archive-date=21 May 2006}}</ref> is a Welsh [[swimmer]].

Gould was born in [[Beveren]], Belgium.<ref name=Gould /> As a member of the [[Wales]] team at the [[2006 Commonwealth Games]],<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.farnhamherald.com/news/julie-hopes-for-a-golden-swim-159056 |title=Julie hopes for a golden swim |work=[[Farnham Herald]] |date=22 February 2006}}</ref> she finished 7th in the [[Swimming at the 2006 Commonwealth Games - Women's 400 metres individual medley|400&nbsp;m individual medley]] with a time of 4:51.90,<ref>{{cite web |title=Swimming: 400m indiv medley |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport2/hi/commonwealth_games/4783242.stm |publisher=BBC Sport |access-date=2 August 2021 |date=21 March 2006}}</ref> and 8th in the [[Swimming at the 2006 Commonwealth Games - Women's 200 metres individual medley|200&nbsp;m individual medley]] with a time of 2:20.61.<ref>{{cite web |title=Swimming: 200m indiv medley |url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/sport1/hi/commonwealth_games/results/4783236.stm |publisher=BBC Sport |access-date=2 August 2021 |date=20 March 2006}}</ref>
